component.name: Myuzik
component.summary: Personal Navidrome player with synced lyrics

description.p: Myuzik is a lightweight native music player for a self-hosted Navidrome server. It streams your library, shows synced lyrics from Navidrome or LRCLIB, and can pin a lyrics overlay above other windows on GNOME.

ul.li: Browse recent, starred, artist, and playlist views
Pinned desktop lyric overlay (GNOME Shell extension)
MPRIS media controls, scrobbling, and search
Low memory footprint using GPUI and GStreamer

description.p: First functional release: library, playback, lyrics, overlay, MPRIS, search, settings.
